product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Shubh Labh Hanging Pair with Pearl Tassels and Golden Embroidery
product_description: Enhance your festive home decor with this elegant handcrafted Shubh Labh hanging pair, beautifully designed with vibrant pink lotus-inspired motifs, intricate golden embroidery, delicate pearl borders, and luxurious black-and-gold detailing. Featuring auspicious Shubh Labh lettering, decorative pearl embellishments, and graceful pearl tassels, these traditional hangings add a charming and festive touch to your home. The combination of bright pink, golden accents, and creamy white pearls creates a rich and elegant appearance. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, temple entrances, walls, and festive spaces, this decorative pair is ideal for Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Bring home traditional artistry and timeless festive elegance with these beautiful decorative hangings.
product_care_suggestion: Gently clean with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid washing or exposing the product to water, as moisture may damage the embroidery, pearls, and decorative materials.
Keep away from direct sunlight for extended periods to preserve the vibrant pink color and golden finish.
Handle the pearl tassels and decorative motifs carefully to prevent tangling, stretching, or breakage.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Store in a cool, dry place inside a soft cloth bag or protective box when not in use.
Keep away from sharp objects to prevent damage to the embroidery and embellishments.
Hang securely using the attached loops and avoid pulling the decorative elements.
